record.paper_title: Operations Research challenges in forestry: 33 open problems
record.original_question: Seasonality, road access, harvesting, and timber transportation interact strongly at the tactical level, and road-building decisions introduce binary structure into already large mixed-integer models. The open question is how to build and solve an integrated tactical model for harvesting, transportation, and road building on large forests while respecting spatial and environmental constraints.

evidence.quote: Open Problem 11 How can we model and solve integrated harvesting, transportation and road building for large-scale forests considering spatial and environmental constraints?

artifact.category_tag: Forest operations research / integrated MIP planning
artifact.status_search_result: Significant progress has been made: integrated MIP models combining harvest scheduling, road building, and transportation have been formulated and solved using model tightening, Lagrangean relaxation, and metaheuristics, with reported cost reductions and applications to industrial cases. However, scaling exact methods to very large forests under full spatial/environmental constraints remains an active research area, so the problem is best described as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Integrated forest harvest planning and road-building model with consideration of economies of scale
status_evidence.snippet: Integrated harvesting, road construction, and transportation decisions reduce costs 15–45% versus sequential planning.
status_evidence.claim: Integrated MIP models for harvesting, road building, and transportation have been developed and solved on real instances.

status_evidence.title: Solving the integrated forest harvest scheduling model using metaheuristic algorithms
status_evidence.snippet: Metaheuristic algorithms are applied to solve the integrated forest harvest scheduling model.
status_evidence.claim: Metaheuristic approaches have been used for large-scale integrated forest planning.

status_evidence.title: Model tightening for integrated timber harvest and transportation planning
status_evidence.snippet: Model tightening by logical inequalities, lifting, and branching strategies improves solvability.
status_evidence.claim: Exact solution techniques have been advanced via formulation tightening.

status_evidence.title: A Problem of Forest Harvesting and Road Building Solved Through Model Strengthening and Lagrangean Relaxation
status_evidence.snippet: Lagrangean relaxation combined with model strengthening solves harvesting–road-building problems.
status_evidence.claim: Decomposition methods have been applied successfully but scalability with full spatial/environmental constraints remains challenging.
